note: One record per PF_* index of the WDK 7.1 winnt.h (name and index are read from that file by gen_x86sys.py), with the documented meaning (MSDN IsProcessorFeaturePresent, Windows 7) and the basis of its value on the declared machine. basis.cpuid: the feature is the CPUID bit the Intel SDM Vol 2A (CPUID, Table 3-10/3-11 feature flags) defines for that meaning, read from verify/cpuid_model.json with its declared masks. basis.absent_if_cpuid_clear: the documented meaning needs the hardware feature, so a clear CPUID bit gives FALSE. basis.undecided: no pinned source gives the value; the blocker is named, and no value is chosen. Indices above the last one the WDK defines: the MSDN return value (zero when the feature is not supported).
meaning_source: MSDN, IsProcessorFeaturePresent function (Windows 7 / Windows Server 2008 R2 documentation)

0.meaning: On a Pentium, a floating-point precision error can occur in rare circumstances

basis.undecided: an erratum of one CPU stepping; no pinned source gives the declared CPU's errata (the CPUID record holds no stepping errata)

1.meaning: Floating-point operations are emulated using a software emulator

basis.undecided: operating-system state (CR0.EM and the emulator of the kernel); no WDK 7.1 or MSDN source states it for the declared machine (cr0.em is undecided in the same record)

2.meaning: The atomic compare and exchange operation (cmpxchg8b) is available

3.meaning: The MMX instruction set is available

4.meaning: The PowerPC 64-bit move instruction is available

basis.undecided: the meaning is a PowerPC feature; whether Windows 7 x86 answers it by the architecture is not stated by a pinned source

5.meaning: The Alpha byte instructions are available

basis.undecided: the meaning is an Alpha feature; whether Windows 7 x86 answers it by the architecture is not stated by a pinned source

6.meaning: The SSE instruction set is available

basis.undecided: the 3DNow bit (CPUID 0x80000001 EDX[31]) is defined by the AMD APM, which is not a pinned source; the Intel SDM does not define it
operating-system boot state (PAE follows the DEP/NX boot policy of the install); no WDK 7.1 or MSDN source states it for the declared machine

10.meaning: The SSE2 instruction set is available

11.meaning: PF_SSE_DAZ_MODE_AVAILABLE (the SSE denormals-are-zero mode is available)

basis.undecided: DAZ support is MXCSR_MASK bit 6 (SDM Vol 1 11.6.4), not a CPUID bit; the declared MXCSR_MASK is not in a pinned source
operating-system state (the DEP policy of the install, boot.ini/BCD nx); no WDK 7.1 or MSDN source states it for the declared machine

13.meaning: The SSE3 instruction set is available

14.meaning: The atomic compare and exchange 128-bit operation (cmpxchg16b) is available

basis.undecided: the MSDN text for this index is not pinned and the name does not decide between cmpxchg8b and cmpxchg16b semantics
operating-system state with no pinned MSDN text

17.meaning: The processor implements the XSAVE and XRSTOR instructions

present_otherwise.undecided: enabled also needs CR4.OSXSAVE, operating-system state with no pinned source

others.source: MSDN IsProcessorFeaturePresent, return value: zero when the feature is not supported; the WDK 7.1 winnt.h defines indices 0..17 only
